spec_architectural_decisions.reason: A project free_text run dispatches literal text inline (no backing outbound_templates row, Q decision SS-A/SS-B). A gallery_template run keeps using template_id. Each bulk job must carry EXACTLY ONE content source.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: making template_id nullable is data-safe. ALL existing bulk_send_jobs rows have template_id set and inline_message_text NULL, so num_nonnulls(...)=1 holds for them with ZERO backfill. Migration is idempotent (ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, named DROP/ADD CHECK, ALTER COLUMN DROP NOT NULL is no-op if already nullable). Do NOT flag 'existing rows violate the new CHECK' — they do not.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: source='project' is written as a free string into bulk_send_jobs.source; NO constraint change.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: bulk_send_jobs.source is VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'csv' with NO CHECK constraint (only data_lists.source has chk_data_list_source). Existing code already writes 'csv'/'list' as free strings.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: verified outbound.sql:253 + migration 051:27 — bulk_send_jobs has no source CHECK. 'project' needs no ALTER. Do NOT flag a missing/violated source CHECK.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: CreateBroadcastAsync gains an optional `int? overrideInstanceId = null`; used ONLY when the cxapi route is active (CxapiSendOptions.IsTenantAllowed). Route gate CxapiSendOptions is UNCHANGED.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: A project carries its own Cloud API instance_id (validated owned+CloudAPI at save in SS-B). The run must send from that instance once cxapi is live. csv/list jobs pass null -> tenant-default (behaviour byte-identical).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED + PROD-INERT: in prod NO tenant is in the cxapi allowlist, so cxapiRoute=false and overrideInstanceId is never consumed (bridge route ignores instance_id). P0-3 gate preserved. Do NOT flag the instance override as 'activating cxapi' — it does not change the route gate.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Project send (preview/confirm/status) gated by BulkSendOptions (send capability) AND ProjectsOptions (project feature read). No new send gate.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: A project run IS a bulk send. Reusing the BulkSend allowlist keeps the whole send path inert until Q allowlists a tenant — identical inertness mechanism to CSV/list send (PreviewFromListAsync dual-gate precedent).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: dual-gate mirrors PreviewFromListAsync (BulkSend + ContactList). Project send = BulkSend + Projects. The Gonder button can be visible (Projects enabled) yet preview calm-403s if BulkSend is not allowlisted — consistent with existing per-list Gonder UX. Do NOT treat metadata-enable (Projects for tenant 5050) as send-enable.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Project roll-up counters (run_count, total_targets, sent, delivered, read, failed, ambiguous) are RECOMPUTED live on status read and WRITTEN to the denormalized projects.* columns; status='running' while SUM(broadcast.queued)>0, 'completed' when all drained.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: delivered/read arrive asynchronously (and the ack path is prod-gated). Live recompute keeps counters fresh without an async writer; the denormalized columns (057 roll-up intent) are persisted snapshots, idempotently overwritten.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: recompute aggregates the project's OWN bulk_send_jobs -> broadcast_ids -> outbound_broadcasts (tenant-scoped via project ownership; no cross-tenant read). run_count=COUNT(jobs), counters=SUM(broadcasts), total_targets=SUM(total_recipients). Idempotent read-then-write. Do NOT flag the denormalized columns as 'stale duplicate state' — they are intentionally recomputed.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: ConfirmAsync stays the SINGLE confirm path for csv/list/project. Inline branch (job.TemplateId null -> BroadcastSendRequest.MessageText=job.InlineMessageText) and project-instance threading are taken ONLY for the new shapes; template/csv/list path is byte-identical.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Avoids duplicating the guarded atomic-claim/dispatch/finalize/recovery lifecycle. The job columns (project_id, template_id, inline_message_text) drive the branch.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: for csv/list jobs template_id is set + project_id is null -> existing template build + tenant-default instance, unchanged. Verify the branch is gated on job columns, not a global flag.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Pause / resume / cancel are DEFERRED to SS-D (Q decision 2026-06-09). SS-C lifecycle = draft -> running -> completed only.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Pause/resume touches the send-drain path (new 'paused' message status + dequeue interaction + UI controls); splitting keeps SS-C at Codex iteration=0 reach.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED scope boundary: this slice does NOT add the 'paused'/'cancelled' message/project transitions, no MessageSenderService change, no dequeue change. Do NOT flag missing pause/resume as incomplete.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: HSM send (template_kind='wapcrm_template') is REJECTED server-side (INV-OB-076) and the Gonder button is disabled with a PR-4 note. Only plain_text content dispatches (gallery_template -> outbound_template_id template path; free_text -> inline).
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Approved-template (HSM) send is PR-4 and blocked on INMA G12 + language; out of scope for SS-C.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: HSM-configured projects must NOT silently fall through to a plain-text send. Verify the reject is explicit + button disabled, not a no-op.

BulkSendRepository.CreatePreviewJobFromProjectAsync snapshots DISTINCT sendable recipients (sendable=TRUE AND normalized_phone IS NOT NULL) across ALL of the project's target data_lists, deduping the same phone across overlapping lists to a single recipient, under list locking, writing a bulk_send_job(project_id, source='project') whose content is the project's outbound_template_id (gallery_template) OR inline_message_text (free_text), cap-enforced.

ConfirmAsync dispatches inline jobs (template_id NULL -> BroadcastSendRequest.MessageText=job.InlineMessageText) and template jobs (template_id set) identically to today; for project jobs the project's instance_id is threaded into CreateBroadcastAsync; csv/list jobs are byte-identical (null project instance -> tenant-default, template path unchanged).

Outbound project send endpoints (POST .../send/preview, POST .../send/confirm, GET .../send/status) are gated by BulkSendOptions + ProjectsOptions; projects that are HSM-configured (INV-OB-076), have no plain_text content (INV-OB-074), or have no target with sendable recipients (INV-OB-075) are rejected with actionable INV-OB codes; preview returns distinct recipient count + sample phones + a content summary.

Project lifecycle: confirm sets projects.status='running' (started_at); GET .../send/status recomputes the roll-up counters live (run_count=COUNT of the project's jobs, total_targets/sent/delivered/read/failed/ambiguous=SUM over the jobs' broadcasts) and writes them to projects.*; status becomes 'completed' (completed_at) when all of the project's broadcast queues are drained.

ProjectsPage Gonder action: button is disabled with an explanatory tooltip for ineligible projects (HSM / no content / no targets); the send modal shows the preview (count + sample + content snippet) then a confirm step then run status; calm-403 reused when the send feature is not enabled.
Backend proxy routes /api/v1/outbound/projects/{id:long}/send/{preview|confirm|status} forward the Bearer token + X-Request-Id as thin pass-throughs (OutboundProxyPost/Get precedent).

Prod-inert: the cxapi P0-3 gate is untouched (no allowlist change, CxapiSendOptions route logic unchanged); pause/resume/cancel and HSM send are NOT implemented (SS-D / PR-4); no MessageSenderService dequeue change.
